# The engine's `idempotency-receive-payment-v1` route set (U-132, P21 plan
# §2.2, branch clientledger/receive-payment): payment receive, edit, void,
# unapply, apply, bounce and customer refunds, `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json.
# Client-declared until the pin has it. Append-only for this capability
# name: `keyable-receive-payment` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::ReceivePaymentV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-receive-payment-v1`.
POST /api/v1/customer-refunds
POST /api/v1/payments/receive
POST /api/v1/payments/unapply
POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/apply
POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/bounce
POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/void
PUT /api/v1/payments/{id}
